mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, phone, real_name, points, create_time, update_time, status, role, nickname FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} AND status = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET phone = #{phone}, real_name = #{realName}, points = #{points}, status = #{status}, nickname = #{nickname}, password = #{password}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (username, password, phone, real_name, points, create_time, update_time, status, role, nickname) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{phone}, #{realName}, #{points}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{status}, #{role}, #{nickname})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET points = #{points}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{userId}
